cause: InternVL replied 'B. A woman in a green parka ...'; the parser saw both B and the article A as standalone labels and the runner stopped on the parse assertion. Rows already written are kept and resumed.
fix: parse_answer takes a leading option label first, then falls back to the original unique-label rule. An unparseable reply is logged as PARSE_FAILURE and recorded with answer null instead of stopping the shard. Candidate probabilities, which the analysis uses, are unchanged.
